resources.title: The ALMIGHTY SORCADIN - BG3 Paladin / Sorcerer Honour Build Guide
resources.creator: Cephalopocalypse
resources.noteEs: La build más versátil del juego, explicada a fondo: el Sorcadin (Paladin/Sorcerer) que pega, cura, tanquea, lanza hechizos y lidera diálogos con un solo personaje. Análisis de Cephalopocalypse, con el porqué detrás de cada nivel.
resources.noteEn: The game's most versatile build, explained in depth: the Sorcadin (Paladin/Sorcerer) that hits, heals, tanks, casts, and leads dialogue with a single character. Cephalopocalypse's breakdown, with the reasoning behind each level.

resources.title: BG3 - BEST Open Hand Monk for Honor Mode
resources.creator: Omaha
resources.noteEs: El Open Hand Monk con Tavern Brawler, una de las builds de mayor daño consistente del juego. Guía de stats, elixires de fuerza y progresión para Honour Mode.
resources.noteEn: The Open Hand Monk with Tavern Brawler, one of the highest consistent-damage builds in the game. A guide to stats, strength elixirs, and progression for Honour Mode.

resources.title: Baldur's Gate 3 Gloomstalker Assassin Multiclass Build Guide (with Magic Items!)
resources.creator: Story First Adventures
resources.noteEs: El Gloomstalker Assassin, especialista en daño de primer turno desde el sigilo. Cubre el multiclase Ranger/Rogue y el equipo mágico que potencia la burst del turno uno.
resources.noteEn: The Gloomstalker Assassin, a first-turn burst specialist from stealth. Covers the Ranger/Rogue multiclass and the magic gear that powers the turn-one damage.

resources.title: The BEAR KNUCKLE BRAWLER - BG3 Karlach Honour Build Guide
resources.creator: Cephalopocalypse
resources.noteEs: Build de Karlach centrada en el combate sin armas y el Tavern Brawler, pensada como personaje-companion. Una alternativa de melee bruto al Sorcadin, con el análisis detallado de Cephalopocalypse.
resources.noteEn: A Karlach build centered on unarmed combat and Tavern Brawler, designed as a companion character. A brute-melee alternative to the Sorcadin, with Cephalopocalypse's detailed breakdown.

resources.title: OP PURE 12 GLOOM STALKER Ranger Build in Baldur's Gate 3
resources.creator: Jay Dunna
resources.noteEs: Para quien prefiere una build de clase única sin multiclase: el Gloom Stalker Ranger puro a distancia, simple de ejecutar y fuerte. Versión 2025 con el juego ya parcheado.
resources.noteEn: For those who prefer a single-class build with no multiclassing: the pure ranged Gloom Stalker Ranger, simple to execute and strong. A 2025 version with the game fully patched.
